name: Sasken Technologies Limited

annual_report.business: Sasken Technologies Ltd. provides chip-to-cognition engineering services across semiconductor design, embedded platforms, automotive software, communications infrastructure, satellite ecosystems, and digital engineering for mission-critical industries.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Services business is expected to remain the primary growth driver, supported by expanding Global Capability Center (GCC) engagements and deeper account mining across strategic customers.

The portfolio mix shift toward higher-value services, combined with disciplined execution and operating leverage achieved over recent quarters, is expected to support margin stability over the medium term.
Growth in the product and ODM portfolio will continue to be calibrated through prudent capital allocation and structured operational oversight.

auditor.name: M/s. M S K A & Associates LLP

key_risks: Artificial Intelligence proliferation and transformation changing traditional delivery models and potentially reducing scope of certain services
Customer concentration risks with significant revenue derived from limited number of key customers, industry segments and geographic markets
Geopolitical developments including rising trade tensions and tariffs reshaping global supply chains
Semiconductor industry memory chip shortage presenting near-term supply-side risk for ODM business
